name: GDPR Alert
description: Displays a configurable GDPR consent alert/banner.
project_description:
This module allows you to display a GDPR consent alert bar.

 Features 
 
 Position alert bar either on top or bottom of page. 
 Configure whether alert can be dismissed or not. 
 Cookie expiration is configurable. 
 Supports alert per language. 
 
 Additional styling will be required to match your theme. Base styling is provided, but can certainly be overrided.

 Requirements 
 No special requirements at this time.

 Installation/Setup 
 Recommended to install via composer and drush.

 
 Install and enable module, like any other contrib module. 
 Configure GDPR alert message/settings at `(admin/config/gdpr-alert)`. 
 Fill in any required fields and save. After saving, render cache will be flushed.
